fix_commit_msg: Fixed Issue #1147 that w-type shifts do not throw illegal instruction trap in RV32GC
description: Fixed Issue #1147 that w-type shifts do not throw illegal instruction trap in RV32GC

@@ -300,7 +300,6 @@ module controller import cvw::*;  #(parameter cvw_t P) (

   assign IllegalERegAdrD = P.E_SUPPORTED & P.ZICSR_SUPPORTED & ControlsD[`CTRLW-1] & InstrD[11]; 
-  //assign IllegalBaseInstrD = 1'b0;
   assign {BaseRegWriteD, PreImmSrcD, ALUSrcAD, BaseALUSrcBD, MemRWD,
           ResultSrcD, BranchD, ALUOpD, JumpD, ALUResultSrcD, BaseW64D, CSRReadD, 
           PrivilegedD, FenceXD, MDUD, AtomicD, CMOD, unused} = IllegalIEUFPUInstrD ? `CTRLW'b0 : ControlsD;
